race.comment: PHILATELIC (9) returned from a six-month spell in excellent order last start, missing by a whisker over 1300m at Hawkesbury. Took out his maiden at the second run back from a spell. Only needs to hold that form from last start to be right in the finish again. CELTIC SIN (7) appreciated a return to the provincials when beaten under a length last time out over this course and distance against the mares. Very fit and although drawn out in the car park she is ready to find peak form after four runs back. DIAMOND MODEL (13) was a very good second two back in a BM68 here at this distance then struggled over the Randwick mile most recently. In the right race to bounce back to form. VEXXY (14) lined up for the first time in ten months, and only the second time overall, when a commendable fourth last start over 1250m here. Can improve sharply out to today's journey with that last run on board. PRINCE HARRISON (10) is yet to miss the frame in three runs at the trip - must be kept safe.
